events.label: Departure from Whitwall
events.summary: Ralph leaves Whitwall with Clement's armed merchant company.

refs.q: This is also a farewell to the House where I was born and bred

opportunities.idea: Status display by tiers of plate shelves as a wealth signal in town houses.

basis_refs.q: the cupboard was of five shelves

ledger.summary: Blaise shows Ralph his new house (Hercules arras, a five-shelf cupboard of silver and gold), gives him a purse of gold and a fine anlace, and reminds him of Whitwall's coming muster. Ralph joins Clement's company in Petergate: five chapmen with their lads and a score of men-at-arms, Clement himself armed. Ralph says farewell to Richard and they ride out.
ledger.geography_notes: none beyond Whitwall's Petergate and gates.
